# Quit Smoking Hub

> A structured knowledge and experience platform for people trying to quit smoking:
> nicotine dependence, withdrawal, cravings, triggers, relapse and evidence-based
> cessation methods. Community experiences are de-identified and clearly separated
> from scientific evidence. This file lists the pages of quitsmokinghub.com; the
> structured research and evidence database lives in the companion data site at
> data.quitsmokinghub.com.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://quitsmokinghub.com/): quit smoking with better information — three entry points: quit, withdrawal, relapse.
- [Start Here](https://quitsmokinghub.com/start/): first steps, quit date, preparation checklist.
- [How to Quit Smoking](https://quitsmokinghub.com/quit-smoking/): evidence-based overview of the quitting process.
- [Nicotine Withdrawal](https://quitsmokinghub.com/withdrawal/): symptom overview with science vs community distinction.
- [Cravings](https://quitsmokinghub.com/cravings/): why cravings happen and how to manage them.
- [Smoking Triggers](https://quitsmokinghub.com/triggers/): trigger database (coffee, alcohol, stress, driving, etc.).
- [Relapse & Recovery](https://quitsmokinghub.com/relapse/): lapse vs relapse, recovery after a slip.
- [Real Quit Experiences](https://quitsmokinghub.com/experiences/): de-identified structured community experience database.
- [Quit Methods](https://quitsmokinghub.com/methods/): cold turkey, gradual reduction, NRT, behavioral support.
- [Quit Smoking Medications](https://quitsmokinghub.com/medications/): NRT, varenicline, bupropion, cytisine evidence pages.
- [Quit Timeline](https://quitsmokinghub.com/timeline/): hour-by-hour, day-by-day, year-by-year — science vs community.
- [Popular Questions](https://quitsmokinghub.com/questions/): direct answers to common quit-smoking questions.
- [Quit Tools](https://quitsmokinghub.com/tools/): practical tools and checklists.
- [Research Highlights](https://quitsmokinghub.com/research/): key studies in plain language.
- [Methodology](https://quitsmokinghub.com/methodology/): how community data is collected, de-identified and evidence-checked.
- [Medical Disclaimer](https://quitsmokinghub.com/disclaimer/): what this site is and is not.

## Data site (data.quitsmokinghub.com)

- [Data Home](https://data.quitsmokinghub.com/): research database and evidence library.
- [Research](https://data.quitsmokinghub.com/research/): structured research records with evidence strength.
- [Guidelines](https://data.quitsmokinghub.com/guidelines/): clinical guidelines from WHO, US Surgeon General, NICE.
- [Nicotine](https://data.quitsmokinghub.com/nicotine/): what nicotine is and how dependence works.
- [Withdrawal](https://data.quitsmokinghub.com/withdrawal/): the science of withdrawal symptoms.
- [Medications](https://data.quitsmokinghub.com/medications/): evidence pages for cessation medications.
- [Health Effects](https://data.quitsmokinghub.com/health-effects/): what smoking does and what quitting changes.
- [Definitions](https://data.quitsmokinghub.com/definitions/): defined terms used across the platform.
